ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
Pony ORM is easy to use and powerful object-relational mapper
for Python. Using Pony, developers can create and maintain
database-oriented software applications faster and with less
ffort. One of the most interesting features of Pony is its
ability to write queries to the database using generator
expressions. Pony then analyzes the abstract syntax tree of
a generator and translates it to its SQL equivalent.
about.summary: Pony is a Python Object Relational Mapper (ORM) with beautiful query syntax.

name: pony
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.7.20"

package:
  name: pony
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pony/pony-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 27a48dffd1d1005956ffa96873fb2de5eada639ca266c43db480cadabc860ccd

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: python -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pony
        - pony.orm
        - pony.utils
      pip_check: true
      python_version: 
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Pony is a Python Object Relational Mapper (ORM) with beautiful query syntax.
  description: |
    Pony ORM is easy to use and powerful object-relational mapper
    for Python. Using Pony, developers can create and maintain
    database-oriented software applications faster and with less
    ffort. One of the most interesting features of Pony is its
    ability to write queries to the database using generator
    expressions. Pony then analyzes the abstract syntax tree of
    a generator and translates it to its SQL equivalent.
  homepage: https://ponyorm.com
  repository: https://github.com/ponyorm/pony
  documentation: https://docs.ponyorm.com

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dharhas
    - sdc50
    - synapticarbors
